params.body:
Part of Trendwolves/gentells-studio#86 (the Studio change closes it). Either order of merging is safe.

## Why

The first real check of a report's sources (18 lines) showed two faults on this side:

- A front page was always refused. A brand, a shop or an app is cited by its own site, and the earlier reports hold such sources. The writer had no way to say so.
- A read title kept the site's name on its end, and a page that names no publisher got its host as publisher.

## What changes

`core/report-source-list.mjs`:

- `holdSources` holds a front page when its entry carries `site_itself: true`; without it the refusal stays. The check's reason now says when a front page is right.
- `tidyTitle` drops the site's name from the end of a read title when it matches the publisher; a dash inside a title stays.
- `tidyPublisher` leaves the publisher empty when the page only gave its host, so the writer names it.

## Checked

`test/report-source-list.test.mjs` 11 of 11, full suite 1739 of 1739, `tsc` clean.
params.title: Report source list: a site that is itself the source can be held, and read titles are tidied
